responsibility: Acts as the central MIR module surface, wiring together MIR submodules and re-exports while defining the core shared MIR data structures and utilities that are not isolated into syntax-only or helper files, such as body/source identity, promoted indices, CFG locations and dominance queries, and other cross-cutting MIR types used throughout analysis, transformation, and printing.
same_name_distinction: Unlike `mir/interpret/mod.rs`, which is limited to executing/interpreting MIR, this `mod.rs` is the root of MIR as an IR: it declares the main MIR submodules and defines shared MIR concepts like phases, sources, bodies, promoted indices, CFG positions, and dominance-related utilities.
